newsitem.title: UKRAINE: SOCCER-UKRAINE OUT TO AVOID ERRORS AGAINST ALBANIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UKRAINE OUT TO AVOID ERRORS AGAINST ALBANIA.

text.p: Group nine leaders Ukraine are at full strength for Wednesday's home World Cup qualifier against bottom side Albania and on guard against the over-confidence that cost them two precious points against Armenia in Kiev in May.
"The team is in good shape," soccer federation official Anatoly Gabelko said on Tuesday. "We still hope to qualify."

With just one point from six games and their squad decimated by the violent unrest that rocked the country this year, Albania seem to pose little threat to a side that beat Portugal and held Germany to a draw at home in earlier group games.
Ukraine, who only managed a 1-1 draw with Armenia, top the group standings with 14 points from eight games, with Germany two points behind from two fewer games.

Their fans, hoping to celebrate qualifying for their first major tournament since independence from the Soviet Union, will also be listening eagerly for news from Belfast where Germany play Northern Ireland, whom they have not beaten since 1977,
Portugal, also in contention, host Armenia.
